SELECT
o.CEEA_ORG_ID AS ceeaOrgId, o.CEEA_ORG_CODE AS ceeaOrgCode, o.VENDOR_CODE AS vendorCode, o.CEEA_EMP_NO AS ceeaEmpNo,
coalesce ( GREATEST(nd.EXT_STORAGE_TIME , nd.EXT_RECEIVE_TIME), nd.EXT_RECEIVE_TIME, nd.EXT_STORAGE_TIME ) AS easReceiveTime,
od.DELIVERY_DATE FROM scc_sc_order_detail od JOIN scc_sc_order o ON od.ORDER_ID = o.ORDER_ID left join scc_pr_requirement_line rl on rl.REQUIREMENT_LINE_ID= od.CEEA_REQUIREMENT_LINE_ID LEFT JOIN scc_sc_delivery_note_detail nd ON nd.ORDER_DETAIL_ID = od.ORDER_DETAIL_ID
LEFT JOIN scc_sc_delivery_note n ON n.DELIVERY_NOTE_ID = nd.DELIVERY_NOTE_ID WHERE 1=1
and nd. DELIVERY_NOTE_DETAIL_ID in ( select DELIVERY_NOTE_DETAIL_ID from ( select coalesce ( GREATEST(nd.EXT_STORAGE_TIME , nd.EXT_RECEIVE_TIME), nd.EXT_RECEIVE_TIME, nd.EXT_STORAGE_TIME ) AS easReceiveTime,ORDER_DETAIL_ID,DELIVERY_NOTE_DETAIL_ID from scc_sc_delivery_note_detail nd order by easReceiveTime desc ) temp group by ORDER_DETAIL_ID )
( o.VENDOR_CODE = #{item.vendorCode} AND o.CEEA_ORG_CODE = #{item.ceeaOrgCode} AND o.CEEA_ORG_ID = #{item.ceeaOrgId} AND o.CEEA_EMP_NO = #{item.ceeaEmpNo} )
